title: Near-square-root logarithmic integrality gaps for uniform sparsest cut

abstractEnglish: We construct uniform sparsest-cut instances whose Goemans–Linial semidefinite integrality gap is at least $`c\sqrt{\log n}/(\log\log n)^3`$ along a sequence $`n\to\infty`$. The demand is one between every pair of distinct vertices, and the capacities are nonnegative real numbers. This matches the Arora–Rao–Vazirani upper bound up to a power of $`\log\log n`$.
